claim: John McAfee — speaking on the record in his own voice in a sit-down interview given roughly six years after he fled Belize — stated that during his November-December 2012 flight from the Belize Gang Suppression Unit, the U.S. Embassy in Belmopan denied his pre-arranged entry on orders that the head of embassy security attributed to "the highest authority in the State Department." McAfee identifies that authority as then-Secretary of State Hillary Clinton. McAfee further states that after the April 30, 2012 GSU raid — during which his dog Caramelo was shot dead and he estimates roughly $500,000 of his property was destroyed — he retaliated by donating laptops loaded with viral spyware to Belize government secretaries, and that within a week he had "the entire government computer system" under surveillance. From that intercepted material he says he concluded that the Belize Minister of National Defense was "the largest drug trafficker in all of Central America" and the Minister of Immigration "the largest human trafficker." He withheld the names from the interview — "we don't want to get killed by them either, so we're probably not going to do that." McAfee also restated the Clinton-embassy claim publicly on X (formerly Twitter) on August 11, 2019, more than two years before his June 2021 death in Spanish prison custody.

notes: This is a first-hand account: McAfee on the record, in his own voice on camera, plus two August 2019 tweets restating the same Clinton-embassy allegation. The 2012 year reflects the events McAfee is describing (the November 2012 flight from Belize and the April 30 2012 GSU raid that triggered the chain), not the year of the interview. The record documents what McAfee SAID, on the record, multiple times across multiple years. It does not assert the underlying truth of: (a) Clinton personally directing the embassy block, (b) the two unnamed Belize cabinet ministers actually running drug- and human-trafficking networks, or (c) the precise scope of his alleged spyware operation. Pairs with the existing 2012-mcafee-belize-001 (the GSU raid context) and 2021-mcafee-death-001 (his death in Spanish custody, two years after these tweets).
